boundary: No assertion about arbitrary plugins/readers, runtime binaries, transitive third-party dependency bodies, dynamically constructed paths or future K/tooling. Runtime classpath/cache/native tools must be bound by existing run preparation, not supplied by ledger. This is static implementation support, not formal readiness.

PARENT_SOURCE_AFTER.replacement: candidate_sources working_path bytes + fixed candidate/tree runtime binding

SOURCE_BINDING_BEFORE.replacement: current external_helpers bytes + full runtime source_binding

method: Read matrix and exact candidate Git objects; inspect bounded command wrappers, Gradle build definitions, frontend package/config and literal local script dependencies. Never import or execute product/framework code.
